page.description: The page it is a paragraph of.

rows.description: Its rows by id: each { order, cells }, its cells' words by column id.

embed.description: A card: the YouTube video or the post on X its address names.

title_content.description: Its name: the only place it is kept.

properties.description: A database row's values, by property id.

property_files.description: A database row's pictures, by the id of the Image property holding them.

widths.description: Each column's width, by property id.

wrap.description: The columns whose words keep to one line (false), by property id.

database_views.description: The view each database was last open on, by database id.

findPages.description: Find pages as ⌘K (Quick Find) does: names that start with the words, then names that contain them, then pages with a line that does (that line comes back as excerpt) — at most 12. Without words, the 8 pages changed last. Never the trash. Each has its id (the page_id of the other commands; open it with open {page: "/?page=<id>"}), name, kind and place (the pages above it).

exportMarkdown.description: Read a page as Markdown, as Notes copies it: its paragraphs in order with the blocks shown in it — headings, lists, to-dos, quotes, code, tables, dividers, links and page mentions; pictures and files by name. version_id reads a checkpoint from its history (list_versions) instead. A database's rows are list_rows'.

page_id.description: The page: its id (find_pages, list_pages, whats_open). Left out, the page open in the window.

version_id.description: A checkpoint of the page's, from list_versions.

getBacklinks.description: The pages that link to a page, as its Backlinks count them: links from outside the page it lives in only.

page_id.description: The page: its id (find_pages, list_pages, whats_open). Left out, the page open in the window.

listRows.description: A database's rows in a view's order: its filter, then its sorts (first key first); rows alike keep the order they were added in. view_id is the database's first view unless said; search keeps rows whose name contains the words. Each row is a page — its id, name, and values by property id (property ids and views are in the database page's record, get_page). Paged: pass next_cursor back as after.

page_id.description: The database page: its id. Left out, the page open in the window.

listVersions.description: A page's history: the checkpoints kept of it (at most 20, none older than 30 days), oldest first — each with its id, summary, author and time. Read one with export_markdown {version_id}; bring one back with restore_version.

page_id.description: The page: its id (find_pages, list_pages, whats_open). Left out, the page open in the window.

createPage.description: Make a page, as New page does: at the top level, inside a page (it lives there, as a file in a folder, and a link to it goes at the end of that page's words; expanded shows it there in place, as a block), or inside a database (a row of it). kind database makes a database whose first view is view (table unless said). title, icon (an emoji) and text (its first paragraph) are optional; add more with import_markdown. The window stays where it is. Answers the new page.

parent_id.description: The page or database it goes in; left out, the top level.

kind.description: A page of words, or a database.

expanded.description: Its link in its parent page shows it in place, as a block.

updatePage.description: Rename or decorate a page: its title (a rename keeps the links on the words it leaves), icon (an emoji; empty for none), cover (one of Notes' gradients; empty for none — it replaces a cover picture), full_width, and font. A database row's values are set with set_row_property.

page_id.description: The page: its id (find_pages, list_pages, whats_open). Left out, the page open in the window.

icon.description: An emoji, or empty for none.

cover.description: A gradient, or empty for none.

movePage.description: Move a page — its row, and everything in it — as Move to does: under another page (parent_id), or to the top level (top_level). Never into itself or a page inside it, into a database or into the trash; a shared page stays where it is shared, and a page leaves a shared tree only for someone with Full access.

page_id.description: The page: its id (find_pages, list_pages, whats_open). Left out, the page open in the window.

duplicatePage.description: Copy a page with everything in it, as Duplicate does: named "<name> (copy)", its row right after the original's, every page and paragraph under a fresh id; a database row keeps its values. Answers the copy.

page_id.description: The page: its id (find_pages, list_pages, whats_open). Left out, the page open in the window.

archivePage.description: Move a page and everything in it to the trash, as Move to trash does: links to it stay, reading as in the trash, and restore_page brings it back.

page_id.description: The page: its id (find_pages, list_pages, whats_open). Left out, the page open in the window.

restorePage.description: Bring a page back from the trash, as Restore does: into the page it lived in, or the top level when that is gone. A page in the trash with a page above it comes back with that one.

page_id.description: The page in the trash.

deletePage.description: Delete a page in the trash for good — everything in it and its history — as Delete permanently does. It cannot be undone, so a page not in the trash is refused: archive_page first.

page_id.description: The page in the trash.

setFavorite.description: Star or unstar a page in the person's own Favorites. Nothing on the page changes — it may be shared — and nobody else sees it.

page_id.description: The page: its id (find_pages, list_pages, whats_open). Left out, the page open in the window.

favorite.description: true to star, false to unstar.

createBlock.description: Add a paragraph to a page: its kind (text unless said; headings, todo, bullet, numbered, quote, callout, divider, code, file, embed) with text or content (runs with marks, http(s) or #page links, page and date mentions), checked, language, color, icon, align. target_page_id links a page at the end of its words — alone, the line stands for the page; file shows an existing file paragraph's bytes, and any other kind takes a picture already in Notes at the end of its words (source_file_block_id); embed_url makes a YouTube or X card. text.description: Its words, plain (or content, not both).

content.description: Its words as runs with marks, links and mentions (or text, not both).

color.description: Its colour, or a _background highlight; empty for none.

source_file_block_id.description: A paragraph holding a picture, or a file paragraph, whose bytes it shows: a file paragraph's become this one's; a picture's go at the end of its words.

embed_url.description: A YouTube video or a post on X: makes the paragraph its card.

align.description: Where its words — and a picture among them — stand across the line; unset, at its start.

parent_block_id.description: The paragraph or block it goes inside, last.

updateBlock.description: Change a paragraph — its words (text or content), kind, checked, language, color, icon, link target, file or card — as the editor does. block_id.description: The paragraph, or the block shown in place.

groupBlocks.description: Make a block of paragraphs, as Turn into block does: the run of them becomes a page of its own, shown in place where they were; title names it. Answers the block's page id.

ungroupBlock.description: Take a block apart, as Ungroup does: its paragraphs stay where they are, in the page around it, and the block's page goes.

block_id.description: The block shown in place: its page's id.

index.description: Where it goes among the properties; last unless said.
